title: 11 dead, over 180 hospitalised after drinking illicit alcohol in India
paragraphs: 11 dead, over 180 hospitalised after drinking illicit alcohol in India
Deaths from illicit or adulterated alcohol are regularly reported in India, where cheap liquor sold outside regulated channels can contain methanol, a highly toxic industrial chemical.
NEW DELHI: At least 11 people have died and more than 180 have been hospitalised after drinking suspected tainted alcohol in India's northeastern state of Manipur.
